enchantments.tooltip: Invisibility Guard: This item has a chance of granting you temporary invisibility when you are hit by foes. The invisibility will not be removed when you attack or take damage, but it will wear off after 10 seconds.
Fortification +150%: +150% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Lesser Displacement: Equipping this item causes light to distort around you. Attacks from enemies have a 25% chance to miss you due to concealment.
Insightful Fortitude Save +2: This item gives a +2 Insight bonus to your Fortitude saves.
Mythic Trinket Boost +1 or +3: +1 or +3 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
